title: Very lightweight and very small
text: Very lightweight and very small. These are not what I expected. They are so thin and light and just over 3 inches tall. They seem most appropriate for a toddler cup. They sit flat without wobbling and the rim does have a heavy lip around it so liquid tends to get caught there.
